recipes.name: JPs Chicken Sandwich
recipes.generated_description: A boneless chicken breast brines overnight in buttermilk, gets a seasoned flour-and-cornstarch dredge, and comes out of the fryer brushed with a hot paste of cayenne, chili powder, smoked paprika, black pepper, and brown sugar. It goes on a buttered, toasted brioche bun with JP's sauce, dill pickle chips, and a vinegar-dressed cabbage and carrot slaw. Genuinely hot, with tang and a little sweetness to balance it.
recipes.generated_description_short: Buttermilk-brined fried chicken breast brushed with cayenne paste, slaw, pickles, and JP's sauce on brioche.
